![LuckyCasino menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RedstoneNugget/LuckyCasino/main/docs/menu.png)

**A complete casino inside Minecraft, played with virtual chips.** Client-side only: no server mod needed, works on any server, singleplayer included. German and English.

> **Play money only.** Chips are virtual and stored locally. No real items, no server currency, nothing to buy, no network access.

## Games

| Game | |
|---|---|
| **Slot Machine** | 3 reels, jackpot 1000×, auto-spin |
| **Roulette** | European wheel, all common bets, up to 36× |
| **Coin Flip** | Heads or tails, with "double or nothing" |
| **Blackjack** | 6 decks, blackjack pays 3:2, dealer hits soft 17 |
| **Crash** | The multiplier rises, cash out in time (optional auto stop) |
| **Scratch Cards** | Scratch them free with the mouse |
| **Plinko** | 3 risk levels, several balls at once |
| **Mines** | 5×5 grid, 1–20 mines, cash out any time |

## Extras

- Free **daily wheel of fortune**
- **Loot boxes** with titles and frame colours for your collection
- **Daily missions** and **casino levels** with XP
- **Achievements** with toasts, **statistics** with a balance chart, local **leaderboard**
- Movable chip HUD, **emergency loan** at 0 chips, optional **break reminder**
- Luck mode in the settings: *Fair*, *Casino house edge* or *Hardcore*. All odds are documented in the source and checked by unit tests.

## How to use

- Press **K** to open the casino (rebindable in *Options → Controls*)
- **Space** triggers the main action in a game (spin, flip, deal, cash out …)
- Commands: `/casino open`, `/casino balance`, `/casino reset`
- Optional: [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for the settings in the mod list

## Requirements

[Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) ≥ 0.19 and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for Minecraft 1.21.11.
